points.quote: `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (e.g. `'hub'`) and the `parent` and `children` flavour constraints. `flavour` is a namespaced string such as `'affine:note'`.
the `parent` and `children` flavour constraints. These can use group aliases like `'@root'` and `'@content'`.
`toModel: () => new NoteBlockModel()` creates the model instance. The model class extends `BlockModel`

The component is a Lit element extending `BlockComponent<Model>` ... `this.renderChildren(this.model)` renders child blocks. ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal`affine-note`)` maps a flavour to a static Lit tag.
A `ViewExtensionProvider` subclass bundles these registrations ... A `ViewExtensionManager` ... takes the list of providers.
`effect()` runs the element registrations ... `this.isEdgeless(context.scope)` lets it register a different view for page mode and edgeless mode.
